messages:
emma: tiny heads-up for tomorrow's LAN: building power maintenance might toggle breakers 5-6pm. can we plan a graceful reconnect?
raj: thanks for the notice. i can bring a small UPS (600VA) to keep routers and one switch alive during blips.
brad: useful. i'll unplug non-essential chargers during the window so we don't trip anything.
claire: do we have a spare EU->US adapter? i've got a friend visiting with a Switch dock that's EU prongs.
oliver: i have two international adapter bricks in the supply bin, labeled INT-1/INT-2.
emma: perfect. if someone can keep the UPS on until 6:10 that should cover the window.
raj: quick UPS tip: set the shutdown threshold to 20% and enable audible alarm mute if it chirps.
claire: can someone post a short checklist for power reconnection? last time we mixed up switch uplinks.
brad: simple checklist:
1) power on switch first
2) wait 30s
3) power on router
4) verify DHCP on 10.10.20.x
5) then bring up consoles/laptops

raj: also, label the uplink port with tape so we don't plug the wrong cable.
infra-bot: note: Maintenance window Tue 5:45 PM - 6:15 PM in Building A. Network team on call: raj.
emma: thanks bot. tiny poll: should we run mini "surge-safe" tournament during the window (low-stakes) or pause games? react :one: to play through (we rely on UPS) :two: to pause.
oliver: :two: - prefer pause and avoid save corruptions.
brad: :one: - quick chaos if UPS holds.
claire: :two: - vote to pause, then small snack break.
emma: tally so far: pause wins 2-1. i'll post a 10min snack break schedule.
calendar-bot: "Mezz LAN - Power Aware" created by emma for Tue 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM. Location: Mezzanine A.
emma: ok plan — snack break at 5:50pm, power hold until 6:20pm, then reconnection checklist in pinned message. bring adapters and label cables. see you! :plug:
